07f6c691794843a0b5c4aaf989cea8d8.brief:
Set up an AI agent that runs on its own machine, remembers you, and keeps working after you close your laptop.

You'll install it, connect your Claude or ChatGPT plan, turn a task into a skill, schedule a job that messages you on Slack, and run it free with Ollama.

Every command and setting is in the guide under Resources.

258056a4f91e4466ba55ceb9f83768a5.brief:
Install DeepSeek Harness with one command and connect a model through OpenRouter, or run it free on your own computer with Ollama.

Then hand long jobs to the Claude Code plan you already pay for.

Every command, including the Ollama and sub-agent setup, is in the guide under Resources.

2855b39591944bcf8d35cfd217c96842.brief:
Build a research agent in Claude Code that pulls the top content on any topic from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and X, then put it on a schedule.

No code. The finished skill is free, and the exact prompt I used is in the guide under Resources.

858e2125dead4c04bdffdd502a8da48e.brief:
Connect your apps once through Arcade and use them everywhere: Claude Code, the Claude desktop app, your own Python agents, and a morning briefing that runs itself.

The course code is free. All 8 steps, with every command and prompt, are in the guide under Resources.

Connect Claude Code to Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Slack and ClickUp through one Arcade MCP server, then run one prompt that works across four of them.

No code. The steps and the prompts are in the guide under Resources.
